Parent #1926 (SC-03, SC-08) / #1645 (SC-10 route-switch element). Scoped child adding the browser-level route-switch witness.

## Requirements: A live route switch keeps the renderer and its stream

#2126 proves P2P and Relay observe one Agent stream timeline, and #2129 proves a forced route flip revokes the parser-applied cursor. Neither drives the switch a user actually performs: re-attaching the same Session on the other route from the attach dialog while the terminal is live.

The fixture must:

- attach a Session over P2P, mark the current xterm DOM node, print a pre-switch marker, and wait for it exactly once;
- re-attach the same Session over Relay **through the existing attach settings dialog** (no test-only route control);
- assert the same xterm node survives, the pre-switch marker still occurs exactly once, and a post-switch marker arrives exactly once;
- switch back Relay → P2P and prove a numbered burst that spans the cut has an exactly-once retained tail (no duplicate, no missing tail line).

Degraded-vs-synchronized surfacing is out of scope here (tracked by #2155); this issue is about continuity of the renderer and the stream across an operator-visible switch.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 A P2P→Relay re-attach through the attach settings keeps the same xterm node; the pre-switch marker remains exactly once and a post-switch marker arrives exactly once.
- [ ] SC-02 A Relay→P2P re-attach back does the same, and a numbered burst spanning the switch has an exactly-once retained tail.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality / E2E / Case Smoke / trusted Acceptance, and exact merge-SHA Quality / E2E / Cases / Orchestrator Pass.
